parts.name: Electronic Lift System - Linear Leg Unit

Includes 12 programmable height settings, and a digital readout of current height

corrected: 50007: notes "Works with the Electronic Lift System (2372) and Electric Column Lift System kits (50020, 50021, 50041)." -> restated as the page's own claim (compatible with all 80/20 electric lift systems) with the chunk's lift systems given as examples
remaining_doubts: 2372 is the only part number printed for the Electronic Lift System and sits in the Linear Leg Unit table; whether it is the complete kit or a single leg unit is not stated on the page.

Cables 50004 (Sync Cable), 50005 (Motor Extension Cable) and 50006 (Remote Control Extension Cable) on page 7-97 carry no series badge, so they are kept only in the column lift kit notes rather than as standalone parts.
Pages 7-94 to 7-97 have garbled text-layer encoding; all values on those pages were verified against zoomed page images only.
